sourceLimitations: This supplement parses the complete 6909-byte small preload, not any large main/renderer bundle. Complete Program parsing and coordinates do not imply semantic review of every unrelated preload feature.

Program binding identity is a source lexical fact. Actual require("electron") return object, ipcRenderer property identity, global window identity, callback dispatch, transfer validation, MessagePort delivery and main-process receiver behavior remain unverified.
The source direct-write scan cannot establish absence of external object mutation or runtime effects. It records observed syntax only.
No product mode or ChatGPT-only exclusion is inferred from the generic connect-app-host/channel names. Confirmed exclusions remain zero.

Only selected first-party declaration/callback/argument source snippets are retained; the full source and external Electron/Babel implementations are not generated. Existing baseline and older artifacts are unchanged.
No full bundle AST or whole module lexical reaching-definition/reassignment closure. Unique text markers select finite complete source nodes only.
The passed getContextForWebContents/isTrustedIpcEvent functions, actual context instance, port peer, initializer order and live sender/frame checks were not executed or independently traced.

Required base/RPC implementations in startup-requirements, applicationNetwork implementation, imported header/token/error/stream helpers and global runtime builtins remain external/third-party-or-first-party-unknown boundaries. No third-party implementation is copied.
Complete hXe and Ude class locators preserve exact context but only listed members and specifically identified assignments/registration nodes were semantically reviewed.
No environment values, credentials, account data or personal history were accessed; no target/UI/model/network was executed. Request/header/auth strings describe static code contracts only.

Prior shared-origin journal spans are reused exactly from frozen records; only matching current selected main spans are freshly checked against target source. Prior failures and indirect pin drift remain historical and unresolved.
Mode remains unknown. Provider/channel/window/header names and auth guard presence are not mode evidence and do not justify deleting guards or reducing complete feature goals.
Complete original u0e/M1e/vXe source locators do not mean all other startup/service functionality was semantically reviewed. Only listed bindings/options/construction/setter/getter nodes are claimed.
No complete original Program lexical reaching-definition/reassignment proof or complete y1e/window registration closure was added. Source-qualified local chains are conditional candidates.

The getter is conditional on live registry membership; R starts null. Source call order/construction/setter expressions are not proof of successful startup, a live hXe instance, membership population or later mutation/lifetime.

Trust functions use actual sender/frame/URL/registry candidates; runtime inputs, imported/native/helper effects and successful connection/HTTP behavior remain unobserved. No broad trust-bypass or validated-request claim is made.
Previous host-HTTP unknowns/failures describe their historical frozen scope and are not rewritten or automatically upgraded by this independent supplement.
Source JS is sourcePath/hash/span metadata only; no third-party implementation is copied. No target, UI, network/model task, credential/account/personal-history or environment value was accessed.
Mode remains unknown. Source function/property names do not establish product mode or justify removing guards/reducing complete feature targets.
The import symbol or chunk title is not instance evidence. Identity is source-qualified and scope-limited; selected local identity chain is conditional and runtime unverified.

No full main/bootstrap/networkStartup/requirements bundle AST or whole-module reassignment closure. Complete u0e/vXe/oE locators are parsed for selected identity nodes only; unrelated bodies are not semantically reviewed.

No native/runtime implementation or official public API compatibility was validated. Declared electron42.3.0/zod version specifications are not installed versions. Owl permission activation indicates a runtime-sensitive boundary needing separate source/contract investigation.
NetworkStartup.Xc transport/message parser, imported version/schema/deferred/interop/origin helpers remain opaque; no third-party implementation copied or generated.
No target code/application/UI/network/model/credential/history action was performed; restricted-source policy strings are static descriptions only.

Mode unknown: this source does not prove ChatGPT-only or establish an exclusion. The full independently maintainable client remains incomplete pending other functional/native/runtime/behavior evidence.
One failed read-only Python scout used an unescaped regex literal; attempts/failed-text-scout.json retains this history and is not used as evidence.

modules.name: Preload app-host bridge
modules.responsibility: 接收窗口 message，并通过注入 IPC adapter 转发所选 port；将 channel/envelope 和 transfer list 合同集中管理。
modules.observedBasis: 冻结小 preload 中的 source/window/type guard 与 postMessage(_,void 0,[n])，仅源码与词法关系。
modules.preserve: 保留选定 source/type guard 的顺序和消息值/transfer list。新类型接口不代表旧源码已验证 port 类型或送达。
modules.unresolved: require 返回对象、sender、MessagePort 身份和跨进程送达未知。

modules.name: Main connection and remote view lifecycle
modules.responsibility: 组装注入的 event predicate、context resolver、port/RPC adapter 和 remote view 生命周期，保持连接入口独立。
modules.observedBasis: 选定 QXe 先检查 F，再取 event.ports[0]、可选 createAppHost、连接并 registerAppView；caller options 的实际表达式已存证。
modules.preserve: 保留 host target 与 remote view peer 的方向差异；记录 missing context 时的 undefined target/仍调用连接 factory 候选，不自行补写既有 port guard。
modules.unresolved: RPC/base 实现、实际 peer、端口与 context 实例未知；并非完整 wire protocol 恢复。

modules.name: Window context registry and sender predicate
modules.responsibility: 分别管理 context slot/窗口注册生命周期与 sender/frame predicate，并通过 WindowServices 注入连接入口。
modules.observedBasis: 冻结 M1e slot 初 null；条件 getter 依赖 hasRegisteredWebContents；setter 的完整所选节点与 setWindowContext 调用已保留。
modules.preserve: setter 的已有未销毁窗口注册副作用须作为独立生命周期合同调查并保留；不能把 setter 简化为纯赋值，也不能合并 membership 与 sender predicate。
modules.unresolved: 全 registry populate/unregister closure、实时 frame/URL/slot 值未知；所选 file URL 前缀比较不是精确 pathname 相等。

modules.name: App-host service assembly
modules.responsibility: 仅在 composition root 创建所需 provider 并显式组装 host services，将依赖与 disposal hook 注入。
modules.observedBasis: hXe.createAppHost 所选 provider callback、httpFetch:x 明示服务项、Zde getter 和 origin destroyed disposal hook 已存证。
modules.preserve: 保留 provider callback 的 id/request/signal/progress 与 response observer 边界；host services 与 remote view services 使用不同接口。
modules.unresolved: 其他服务集合、spread helper 全外层绑定、实际创建顺序与实例身份未知。

modules.name: HTTP provider request lifecycle
modules.responsibility: 管理 request id 到 AbortController 的映射、cancel/dispose、callback 调用与 Response bridge 清理。
modules.observedBasis: 选定 Ue/He 节点描述 fetch/cancel/disposal/空 body 清理或 signal 管道 finally cleanup。
modules.preserve: cancel 当前 mapped id 时只 abort；清理按 id 删除。重复 id、callback 返回对象及 stream completion 的有效性不设为已证实前提。
modules.unresolved: request-id 唯一性、base lifecycle、RPC serialization 和 native streams 未验证。

modules.name: Desktop HTTP orchestration
modules.responsibility: 集中 URL/body/header、destination guards、auth/workspace/retry、response/error normalization；网络与身份/helper 通过依赖注入。
modules.observedBasis: 冻结 Ude.fetchHttp/performDesktopFetch/progress request 的有限成员合同。
modules.preserve: URL/log/timing 预处理在 try 外；普通 body 与 progress Buffer.concat 分支分开。认证与错误 helper 保持 opaque，不能声称端到端流式。
modules.unresolved: 实际凭据、response observer、helper 语义、目的地值和网络结果未知。

modules.name: Application network policy and native adapter
modules.responsibility: 围绕显式 policy state 管理 readiness/generation/refresh/session restrictions，再把 fetch/request 委托给 native runtime adapter。
modules.observedBasis: 冻结 tr 的 policy/lifecycle、oa/sa 与 net.fetch/net.request 候选边界。
modules.preserve: 保持 loading/ready/failed、stale generation、redirect/session/dispose；pre-ready仅dev origin或helper-local协议候选，其余null policy拒绝；restricted为https/wss和去尾点hostname精确匹配，不能改为后缀通配。dev origin实际值未知。
modules.unresolved: 实际 requirements/session/allowlist、外层 binding、native API 与真实实例未知。

modules.name: Requirements startup and runtime capability adapter
modules.responsibility: 分开 requirements/config 获取、临时 transport lifecycle、schema boundary 与 Node permission/relaunch capability，以 adapter 限制运行时耦合。
modules.observedBasis: 冻结 Xc 与 requirements da/ta/na 的选定初始化/read/finally-close 和 permission/relaunch 候选。
modules.preserve: 临时 transport 初始化与 read 顺序、finally close 作为待迁移合同；声明 electron 42.3.0 不作为 stock runtime 兼容结论。
modules.unresolved: Us/eo/Lr 与 parser/helpers 归属、backend 结果、Owl/native 实现与兼容性未知。

interfaces.name: Window port and connection adapter
interfaces.semantics: 用 opaque envelope/event/port 类型隔离 window/IPC/native 对象；明确 selected port、void 0 message 和 transfer list，而不把完整 schema/握手当作已恢复。
nonGuarantees: 实际 window sender 身份

interfaces.name: WindowServices registry and sender contract
interfaces.semantics: 拆开 membership、context slot 与 sender/frame/URL predicate。setWindowContext 含注册副作用调查项；保留 null/id/mainFrame/file-prefix 源码区别。

interfaces.name: Directional host and remote view capabilities
proposedContract: HostTarget.services: opaque host service collection with selected httpFetch
interfaces.semantics: HostTarget 与 RemoteViewPeer 分接口和测试 fixture；所选 httpFetch provider 由 assembly 层注入，不从同名 services 推断共同身份。

interfaces.name: HTTP provider legacy result adapter
proposedContract: dispose(): mapped-controller abort and map clear
interfaces.semantics: LegacyResult 与 opaqueOptions 先保留边界，再逐个补充新类型；Response body bridge 有 empty-body 与 pipe/finally cleanup 两条路径。

interfaces.name: ApplicationNetwork and ClientRequest runtime seam
interfaces.semantics: 将 fetch 与 request 两条 native API 显式分开；progress consumer 仅需求 getUploadProgress/events/end(body)/abort 的所选 surface，返回前有 response buffering。
nonGuarantees: 网络与端到端流式结果

interfaces.name: Requirements and runtime startup ports
interfaces.semantics: 读取、解析、policy 和 permission 激活通过不同 ports 注入；不把未追踪 transport/parser 实现生成到新工程。

dependencyBoundaries.name: Electron IPC and native port boundary
dependencyBoundaries.proposedAction: 仅重建有限桥接 glue；Electron/native MessagePort 由 runtime dependency 或 adapter 提供。建立声明版本与实测兼容记录。
dependencyBoundaries.ownership: named external runtime API boundary; actual objects and compatibility unknown

dependencyBoundaries.name: Native network/session and Owl permission boundary
dependencyBoundaries.proposedAction: 保留 net/session 运行时 adapter；permission/relaunch 单列能力探测与迁移调查项。不能按 package 声明自动宣布 stock Electron 等价。
dependencyBoundaries.ownership: named Electron API plus private/custom-runtime candidate; concrete native implementation unknown

dependencyBoundaries.name: RPC/base/temporary transport unresolved ownership
dependencyBoundaries.proposedAction: 保留 opaque RPC connector/provider base/temporary transport 接缝；先定位协议与库 provenance，再决定是否作为外部依赖。
dependencyBoundaries.ownership: unknown; do not classify all required helpers as third party

dependencyBoundaries.name: Schema and version helper boundary
dependencyBoundaries.proposedAction: 将解析与 version helpers 放在窄 adapter；记录已声明依赖与未知 bundled modification，后续独立核对 package/API 合同。
dependencyBoundaries.ownership: named/opaque required library helpers; installed versions and upstream modification unknown

dependencyBoundaries.name: Auth/header/error/abort and stream helper seams
dependencyBoundaries.proposedAction: 用身份上下文、header/error adapter 和 runtime stream primitives 注入 HTTP 层；只生成应用 glue，未知 provenance 不按文件名剥除。
dependencyBoundaries.ownership: mixed runtime and imported helper boundary; full helper ownership/implementation unknown

migrationValidation.name: Keep a versioned finite contract ledger
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 将本基线 source hash、record span/JSON pointer、producer 原字节 pin 与拟定接口一起版本化；升级时只比较所选合同的变化，再决定下一轮定向调查。
migrationValidation.acceptance: 可逐条定位建议来源；未恢复的协议/native/模式项仍明确 unknown。该建议不声称完整升级兼容。

migrationValidation.name: Synthetic port and directional service fixtures
migrationValidation.phase: offline tests of newly authored code
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 使用自建 envelope/IPC/port/RPC fakes 检查所选 source/type guard、first-port 选择、missing-context 候选路径、host/remote capability 方向及 hook 调用。
migrationValidation.acceptance: fixture 能区分拒绝、转发与两个 services 方向；native sender/送达结果不因 mock 通过而升级。

migrationValidation.name: Context and sender lifecycle fixtures
migrationValidation.phase: offline tests of newly authored code
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 用显式 registry/slot/fake frame/URL 参数覆盖未注册/已注册、setter 注册副作用、mainFrame/null-id 分支及 file URL prefix；完整 unregister/populate 未闭合部分另列调查。
migrationValidation.acceptance: 保留所选分支区别，不把 file prefix 改写为精确 pathname 或把 null sender id 写成必然拒绝。

migrationValidation.name: Provider cancellation and cleanup fixtures
migrationValidation.phase: offline tests of newly authored code
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 用 synthetic callback/body/signal 观察 fetch throw、empty body、pipe completion、cancel、origin disposal 和重复 id 场景；把 collision 结果记录为待决策合同。
migrationValidation.acceptance: 清理与 abort 时间边界可独立断言；不能预设旧源码已有 id uniqueness 或完整 RPC stream completion 保证。

migrationValidation.name: HTTP response/error and progress fixtures
migrationValidation.phase: offline tests of newly authored code
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 用 synthetic transport 覆盖 ok/304/returnErrorResponse 候选、try 内 error mapping、try 前 URL/log/timing throw 与 provider cleanup；普通 body 与 progress 全量 Buffer.concat 分别验证。
migrationValidation.acceptance: 新代码合同清楚区分异常范围与 buffered progress；不声称真实 token、完整 error wire schema 或端到端流式已验证。

migrationValidation.name: Network readiness and generation fixtures
migrationValidation.phase: offline tests of newly authored code
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 注入 synthetic requirements/dev origin/session/clock，覆盖loading等待与failed抛error、stale/disposed refresh、prior deferred完成、pre-ready null policy、restricted精确hostname/协议和unrestricted有效URL/disposed guard，以及redirect/session cancellation。
migrationValidation.acceptance: 状态与 generation 迁移可观察，allowlist 来自 fixture 参数；实际账户/backend/session 值保持未知。

migrationValidation.name: Deferred native and opaque RPC compatibility matrix
migrationValidation.suggestedCheck: 针对自建项目/合成请求，在明确 runtime 与 RPC dependency 版本上验证 IPC/port、net fetch/request events/abort、Response stream、permission/relaunch 与 startup close；先查清未知库 provenance。
migrationValidation.acceptance: 替换依赖的兼容结论需要实际对应合同证据；当前静态提案不授予或代表运行测试完成，不读取真实凭据/history。

toolRuntime.scope: analysis host Python standard library only; not target runtime

limitations: All 26 records are proposals with inferred confidence; suggested paths/interfaces are new design choices, not recovered original directories/types.
This scope is the finite app-host/HTTP/network chain represented by four frozen studies, not full client functionality or all callers/consumers.

Original journal records are reused unchanged. Source byte coordinates/JSON pointers and source hashes are inherited; this proposal does not reread target code or upgrade source, outer-binding, registry, runtime or mode claims.
Only four frozen primary producers have their original bytes pinned; they are not executed or copied. Auxiliary producer/dependency chains and historic indirect pin drift are not revalidated.

RPC/base/helper provenance and custom/native compatibility remain unknown. A required module, chunk label or declared Electron specification cannot justify removing implementation or asserting stock runtime parity.
All migration checks are future, not-run suggestions. Mock/fixture results would not prove native delivery, real account/backend/session values, end-to-end streaming or product mode.
No credentials, environment values or personal history are used. No third-party implementation is generated; Babel and prior host runtimes remain analysis-tool metadata, not application dependencies.
